items.title: Consumer price inflation, UK: December 2024
items.summary: The Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs (CPIH) rose by 4.2% in the 12 months to December 2024, down from 4.3% in November.

items.title: Consumer price inflation, UK: November 2024
items.summary: The Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs (CPIH) rose by 4.3% in the 12 months to November 2024, down from 4.7% in October.

items.title: Consumer price inflation, UK: October 2024
items.summary: The Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs (CPIH) rose by 4.7% in the 12 months to October 2024.
